title: StateHash routes through a fixed 4096-byte buffer and silently returns the FNV offset basis when the state outgrows it
detail: Serialized size is 98 + 14/node + 19/pipe + 48/packet + 18/demand-entry + 19/log-entry; past 4096 SerializeState returns 0 and Fnv1a64(ptr,0) returns FNV64_OFFSET — all oversized states collapse to one constant hash, silently false-greening replay-equality (ODN-11).
recommended_fix: Hash the byte vector SerializeState already builds internally (vector-returning overload or size-query first) instead of a fixed stack buffer; optionally assert N>0.

title: EqualCostHops staleness guard checks only table shape, so querying after ApplyEdit with a grown topology indexes out of bounds
detail: The doc promises ok=false when the table is stale, but NodeSlot resolves against the current topology; in the documented ApplyEdit window (PP_Sim.h:38-39 'derived views rebuild at the next Step') a new node's slot >= R.N makes Idx overrun HopOffset — UB, not false.
recommended_fix: Extend the guard to `R.N != T.NodeAlive.size()` (return false) so a table-vs-topology mismatch is rejected instead of read out of bounds.

title: StepScenario silently drops replay commands beyond 16 per tick
detail: This shared replay-path runner feeds PPProbe and tests; a scenario with >16 same-tick entries silently drops the excess — a deterministic-but-wrong replay with no ReplayError latch, against the never-silent ODN-2 discipline.
recommended_fix: Gather into a std::vector (or count first and assert), so an over-capacity tick fails loudly instead of truncating.

title: spine-check --json hardcodes topology/flow summary literals while the PPProbe writer computes them
detail: SCHEMA.md declares all three golden writers derive from one schema, but PPProbeCommandlet.cpp prints PP::NodeCount/PipeCount/Demand.size() while the standalone pins 3/2/11 — scenario changes drift these keys until literals are hand-edited.
recommended_fix: Print PP::NodeCount(State.Topology), PP::PipeCount(State.Topology), and State.Flow.Demand.size() in the standalone printf, matching the commandlet.
